title.en: Why was this a bad call?
title.hi: यह trade खराब फ़ैसला क्यों था?

problem.en: Ravi, this is your paper trade from onboarding week 2. The day before the policy announcement you bought 4 lots of the 24200 CE at ₹90.25. The next day the index closed 110 points higher, and you sold at ₹59.55. Let's work out why, one step at a time.
problem.hi: रवि, यह onboarding के दूसरे हफ़्ते का आपका paper trade है। Policy announcement से एक दिन पहले आपने 24200 CE के 4 lots ₹90.25 पर खरीदे। अगले दिन index 110 points ऊपर बंद हुआ, और आपने ₹59.55 पर बेचा। चलिए, एक-एक कदम करके समझते हैं कि ऐसा क्यों हुआ।

caseData.exit: D0 15:25 · ₹59.55 · spot 24,150 · IV 11.0% · 2 days to expiry
caseData.pnl: −₹9,210 (−34%) on a paper book, before charges
caseData.event: Scheduled policy announcement, D0 10:00; outcome as expected
caseData.deskRule: Event budget: 1% of a ₹10,00,000 paper book = ₹10,000

disclaimer.en: Education on a past, illustrative trade. Not investment advice.
disclaimer.hi: एक पुराने, illustrative trade पर शिक्षा। यह investment advice नहीं है।

n1-thesis.goal: Surface Ravi's thesis and check whether it covered the size of the move already priced in, not only direction.

say.en: When you bought, what was your thesis?
say.hi: खरीदते वक़्त आपका thesis क्या था?

expect.desc: The thesis is only about direction: the announcement would be positive and the index would rise.
The thesis also says how big a move was already priced in (IV or the implied move) and why he expected more.

say.en: Forget the result for a moment. What did you expect the index to do, and by how many points?
say.hi: Result को एक पल के लिए भूल जाइए। आपको index से क्या उम्मीद थी, और कितने points की?

say.en: On an event day a thesis has two parts: direction, and how big the move will be.
say.hi: Event day पर thesis के दो हिस्से होते हैं: direction, और move कितना बड़ा होगा।

say.en: For example: 'I expect a rise of more than 300 points, bigger than the move the market is pricing.'
say.hi: जैसे: 'मुझे 300 points से ज़्यादा की तेज़ी की उम्मीद है, जो market के price किए move से बड़ी है।'

say.en: Your thesis was direction only. On event days the desk also asks: how big a move is already priced in?
say.hi: आपका thesis सिर्फ़ direction का था। Event day पर desk यह भी पूछता है: कितना बड़ा move पहले से price में है?

chips.text: Policy positive आती, तो market ऊपर जाता। इसलिए call लिया।
IV ऊँचा था, पर मुझे priced move से बड़े move की उम्मीद थी।
पक्का नहीं पता, बस लगा कि ऊपर जाएगा।

n2-premium.goal: Get Ravi to name why the premium fell although spot rose: the IV fall after the event, together with theta.

say.en: The index rose 110 points, so your direction was right. Then why did the premium fall from ₹90 to ₹60?
say.hi: Index 110 points ऊपर गया, यानी direction सही था। फिर premium ₹90 से ₹60 क्यों हो गया?

expect.desc: Names the fall in IV after the announcement (IV crush) as a main cause.
Names time decay (theta) but not the IV fall.

misconceptions.desc: Blames manipulation, 'operators' or a stop hunt instead of how options are priced.

say.en: Apart from spot, which two things does an option's price depend on?
say.hi: Spot के अलावा option की कीमत किन दो चीज़ों पर टिकी होती है?

say.en: What happened to IV after the announcement? Look at the case card.
say.hi: Announcement के बाद IV का क्या हुआ? Case card देखिए।

say.en: IV fell from 17.5% to 11% and a day went by. Both cut the premium.
say.hi: IV 17.5% से 11% पर आया और एक दिन बीत गया। दोनों premium घटाते हैं।

say.en: Together, the IV fall and theta took away more premium than the move added.
say.hi: IV crush और theta ने मिलकर उससे ज़्यादा premium घटाया जितना move ने जोड़ा।

chips.text: Announcement के बाद IV गिर गया, इसलिए premium गिरा।
एक दिन का theta लग गया।
शायद operators ने खेल किया, stop hunt हुआ।

s1-payoff.goal: Show, without telling Ravi he is wrong, that the same spot loses money once IV falls; split the change into move, IV and time.

say.en: Look: same spot, but when IV drops from 17.5% to 11% the whole curve sinks. Your move added ₹40 per unit; the IV fall took ₹48 and one day of time took ₹23.
say.hi: देखिए: spot वही है, पर IV 17.5% से 11% होते ही पूरा curve नीचे खिसक गया। Move ने हर unit पर ₹40 जोड़े; IV ने ₹48 और एक दिन के time ने ₹23 घटाए।

n3-implied-move.goal: Get Ravi to compare the move the market priced (the ATM straddle) with the move that came.

say.en: Before the event, the 24050 straddle cost about ₹304. That's roughly the move the market was pricing. How big was the actual move?
say.hi: Event से पहले 24050 का straddle करीब ₹304 का था। मोटे तौर पर market इतने points का move price कर रहा था। असल move कितना हुआ?

expect.desc: Sees the actual move (+110) was much smaller than the priced move (about ±304), so the option was expensive for the move that came.
Says the outcome was expected or 'already in the price' without comparing the numbers.

say.en: A ₹304 straddle means a move of roughly ±304 points. How far did the index actually go?
say.hi: ₹304 का straddle मतलब लगभग ±304 points का move। Index असल में कितना चला?

say.en: D-1 close 24,040; D0 close 24,150.
say.hi: D-1 close 24,040; D0 close 24,150।

say.en: +110: about a third of the priced move.
say.hi: +110, यानी priced move का करीब एक-तिहाई।

say.en: The market priced ±304 and got +110. An option buyer needs a bigger move than the one priced.
say.hi: Market ने ±304 का move price किया था, आया +110। Option खरीदने वाले को priced move से बड़ा move चाहिए।

chips.text: ±304 price था, आया सिर्फ़ 110। Option महँगा खरीदा।
Result तो सबको पता था, सब पहले से price में था।

n4-sizing.goal: Check that Ravi can compute the premium at risk and compare it with the desk's event budget.

say.en: The desk's event budget is 1% of your book: ₹10,000. How much premium did you put at risk?
say.hi: Desk का event budget आपकी book का 1% है, यानी ₹10,000। आपने कितना premium risk पर रखा?

expect.desc: Computes about ₹27,000 at risk (4 lots × 75 × ₹90.25 = ₹27,075), about 2.7 times the ₹10,000 budget.

misconceptions.desc: Says buying options is safe because the loss is limited to the premium, so size doesn't matter.

say.en: Premium × lot size × lots: what does that come to?
say.hi: Premium × lot size × lots: कितना हुआ?

say.en: ₹27,075: 2.7 times the budget.
When you buy an option, the whole premium is your max loss. So size comes from the budget, not from conviction.
say.hi: Option खरीदने में पूरा premium ही max loss है। इसलिए size budget से तय होता है, भरोसे से नहीं।

chips.text: 90.25 × 75 × 4, करीब ₹27,000। Budget से लगभग तीन गुना।
Option में loss तो premium तक ही limited है, size से क्या फ़र्क पड़ता है?

n5-setup.goal: Measure how quickly Ravi reaches the playbook's event-day process for this past situation: defined risk inside the budget, or standing aside. A reply that only cuts lots matches no branch and routes as unclear, which gives hint 1.

say.en: Same view, same day. Under the desk playbook, what setup would have kept this trade inside the rules?
say.hi: वही view, वही दिन। Desk playbook के हिसाब से कौन-सा setup इस trade को rules के अंदर रखता?

expect.desc: Names a defined-risk structure with a short leg (for example a call spread) sized inside the event budget.
Says no trade, or wait until after the announcement, because the priced move was bigger than his expected move.

say.en: Cutting lots alone isn't enough. What kind of structure does playbook §4 ask for on event days?
say.hi: सिर्फ़ lots कम करना काफ़ी नहीं। Playbook §4 event day के लिए किस तरह के structure की बात करता है?

say.en: A structure with a short leg, so an IV fall hits both legs.
say.hi: ऐसा structure जिसमें एक short leg हो, ताकि IV गिरे तो उसका असर दोनों legs पर बँट जाए।

say.en: For example a 24200/24400 call spread, 2 lots: max loss ₹7,785, inside the budget. On the same day it would have ended at −₹442.50.
say.hi: जैसे 24200/24400 call spread, 2 lots: max loss ₹7,785, budget के अंदर। उसी दिन इसका नतीजा −₹442.50 होता।

say.en: The playbook's answer: a defined-risk structure inside the event budget, or wait until after the announcement.
say.hi: Playbook का जवाब: event budget के अंदर defined-risk structure, या announcement के बाद तक इंतज़ार।

chips.text: Defined-risk: 24200/24400 call spread, 2 lots, budget के अंदर।
Announcement के बाद तक रुकता, जब IV नीचे आ जाता।

n6-rationale.goal: Get Ravi to state, for the desk, why the decision was bad and what his process is next time (expression evidence).

say.en: Now write it for the desk in one or two lines: why was this a bad decision, and what's your process next time?
say.hi: अब desk के लिए एक-दो line में लिखिए: यह फ़ैसला खराब क्यों था, और अगली बार आपका process क्या होगा?

expect.desc: Names the priced-versus-actual move or the IV fall, the sizing breach and the playbook fix, clearly enough for a desk lead.
Names only one or two of the three, or is hard to follow.

say.en: Three things: what happened, which rule broke, what you'll do next time.
say.hi: तीन चीज़ें: क्या हुआ, कौन-सा rule टूटा, अगली बार क्या करेंगे।

say.en: You could start: 'Direction was right, but…'
say.hi: ऐसे शुरू कर सकते हैं: 'Direction सही था, पर…'

say.en: '…IV was high and the priced move was big; size was over budget. Next time…'
say.hi: '…IV ऊँचा था और priced move बड़ा था; size budget से ज़्यादा था। अगली बार…'

say.en: 'Direction was right, but the market priced ±304 and got +110; the IV fall and theta cut the premium; size was 2.7 times the budget. Next time: check the implied move, use defined risk, stay inside the budget.'
say.hi: 'Direction सही था, पर market ने ±304 price किया और आया +110; IV crush और theta ने premium घटाया; size budget का 2.7 गुना था। अगली बार: implied move देखूँगा, defined-risk लूँगा, budget के अंदर रहूँगा।'

c1-conclusion.goal: Close with the conclusion Ravi reached, in his language, and hand off to the scorecard.

say.en: Here's what you worked out.
say.hi: आपने जो निकाला, वह यह है।

summary.en: Direction was right, but the thesis was incomplete. Before the event IV was high and the market was pricing about ±304 points; the move was +110. The IV fall and one day of theta took more than the move added: ₹90.25 became ₹59.55. Size was 2.7 times the event budget. Next time: check the priced move first, use a defined-risk structure inside the budget, or wait.
summary.hi: Direction सही था, पर thesis अधूरा था। Event से पहले IV ऊँचा था और market करीब ±304 points का move price कर रहा था; move आया +110। IV crush और एक दिन के theta ने move से ज़्यादा ले लिया: ₹90.25 का premium ₹59.55 रह गया। Size event budget का 2.7 गुना था। अगली बार: पहले priced move देखें, budget के अंदर defined-risk structure लें, या इंतज़ार करें।

meta.status: Draft for S5 review. Machine-drafted Hindi; needs a native Hindi reviewer and a practising trader.
meta.extraFields: scriptedPath, scriptedScorecard, videoScorecard, sceneStates and meta are additive fields for the video and a replay. They are not part of kiki-tutor-graph/v0; a v0 loader can ignore them.
scoringRules: A metric's level is its latest evidence, except: a branch reached after a hint rung is capped at partial; after the answer rung it is not_yet.
A misconception corrected by a show node leaves that metric at most partial until later evidence.
Words evidence comes from expression.termsUsed; expression evidence from the articulation node and expression.clarity.

metricDefinitions.sentiment: Reads what the market expected: whether the outcome was priced in and how big a move the options were pricing.
metricDefinitions.pattern: Recognises the event-volatility pattern: IV builds into a scheduled event and falls after it, taking premium with it.
metricDefinitions.risk: Computes premium at risk and compares it with the desk's event budget; knows max loss for a long option is the whole premium.
metricDefinitions.timeToRightTrade: Turns and hint rungs Ravi needs to name the playbook-compliant setup for this past situation (defined risk inside the budget, or standing aside). Process on a past trade, never a live pick.
metricDefinitions.articulation: States the diagnosis and next-time process in one or two lines a desk lead would accept.

mapLayout.note: Positions for the small decision-graph map (0 to 1, left to right, top to bottom).

meta.audio: No audio files yet. Pre-generate KiKi's Hindi lines per node with TTS (contract: TutorNode.audio).
